steps.en: The payment status is received from the Payment Gateway
steps.id: Status pembayaran diterima dari Payment Gateway

steps.en: Payment is confirmed as successful with the gateway before it is accepted
steps.id: Pembayaran dikonfirmasi sukses ke gateway sebelum diterima

steps.en: Amount, payment date, receipt number, channel and mode are saved for the payment
steps.id: Jumlah, tanggal bayar, nomor receipt, channel, dan mode pembayaran disimpan

steps.en: The notice is marked permanently suspended and paid on the public side
steps.id: Notice ditandai suspended permanen dan sudah dibayar di sisi publik
steps.why_en: A part-payment is also marked as fully paid on the public side until the later correction runs.
steps.why_id: Pembayaran kurang juga ditandai lunas di sisi publik sampai koreksi berikutnya berjalan.

steps.en: Payments from the AXS channel are received with receipt, amount, date and mode
steps.id: Pembayaran dari channel AXS diterima beserta receipt, jumlah, tanggal, dan mode
steps.why_en: The payment mode reported by AXS is checked but not saved; a fixed value is stored instead.
steps.why_id: Mode pembayaran dari AXS dicek tetapi tidak disimpan; yang tersimpan nilai tetap.

steps.en: Successful payments are pulled from the public side into OCMS regularly
steps.id: Pembayaran sukses ditarik dari sisi publik ke OCMS secara berkala

steps.en: The notice is permanently suspended in OCMS and recorded as paid
steps.id: Notice di OCMS ditandai suspended permanen dan tercatat sebagai dibayar
